"""Preserve the complete actual main validation before updating its tracker."""
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
P = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = P.parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / 'docs/friendly-command-gena-main-validation-proof-archive.json'
assert not OUT.exists()
sha = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
names = ['validate_gena_main_integration.py', 'friendly-command-gena-main-validation.json',
         'friendly-command-gena-main-validation.log', 'gena-main-before-inventory-queue.json.gz']
report_raw = (P / names[1]).read_bytes()
r = json.loads(report_raw)
assert r['state'] == 'passed' and r['head'] == '71c0a41f25a203da7562e3d3c9429a87b8618cc4'
assert r['rust'] == dict(passed=23, failed=0, ignored=0, batches=3)
assert r['python_controls'] == r['expected_python_controls'] == 260
assert len(r['results']) == 12 and all(row['exit_code'] == 0 for row in r['results'])
assert all(r[key] for key in ['source_unchanged', 'head_unchanged', 'index_unchanged', 'protected_binaries_unchanged'])
assert r['producer'] == dict(text=(P / names[0]).read_text(), sha256=sha((P / names[0]).read_bytes()))
assert r['log_sha256'] == sha((P / names[2]).read_bytes())
assert all(sha((ROOT / name).read_bytes()) == digest for name, digest in r['source_inputs'].items())
assert r['compiled_input_identity'] == {'klem': 1146, 'klem-corpus-adapter': 1146, 'klem-web-assets': 18}
files = {}
destination = ROOT / 'docs/friendly-command-gena-main-validation-proof'
destination.mkdir()
for name in names:
    raw = (P / name).read_bytes(); packed = gzip.compress(raw, mtime=0)
    path = destination / (name + '.gz'); path.write_bytes(packed)
    assert gzip.decompress(path.read_bytes()) == raw
    files[name] = dict(path=str(path.relative_to(ROOT / 'docs')), source_sha256=sha(raw), archive_sha256=sha(packed), bytes=len(raw))
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(dict(state='actual-main23-Rust260-controls-passed', files=files,
                              head=r['head'], source_files=len(r['source_inputs']),
                              rust=r['rust'], python_controls=260,
                              all_original_source_head_index_and_protected_binaries_unchanged=True,
                              exact_installed_compile_input_identity=r['compiled_input_identity'],
                              producer=dict(text=Path(__file__).read_text(), sha256=sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes())),
                              scope='Actual named main merge validation; final-main full Nix, quiet timing and contextual/register/independent Korean review remain separate.'), indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(files=len(files), manifest_sha256=sha(OUT.read_bytes()))))
